create_VrsSequenceDataset: create a VrsSequenceDataset from a VRS file path with configurable frame rate, snippet length, and stride
load_snippet_pose: load pose data for a time snippet from the VRS dataset with world-to-rig and snippet-to-rig transforms
load_snippet_semidense: load semidense point cloud data for a time snippet with configurable maximum point count
load_snippet_objects: load oriented bounding box observations for a time snippet with semantic IDs and instance tracking
get_transform_to_vio_gravity_convention: compute a rotation transform to map an arbitrary gravity direction vector to the VIO convention of (0,0,-1)
